Contract Generator.contract:
Contract ProcessSaleService::makeCashPayment(amount: Real): Boolean {
	definition:
		store: Store = CurrentSale.Belongedstore
	precondition:
		CurrentSale.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		CurrentSale.IsComplete = false and
		CurrentSale.IsReadytoPay = true and
		amount>=CurrentSale.Amount
	postcondition:
		let pay: CashPayment in
		pay.oclIsNew() and
		CashPayment.allInstance()->includes(pay) and
		pay.AmountTendered = amount and
		pay.BelongedSale = CurrentSale and
		CurrentSale.AssoicatedPayment = pay and
		store.Sales->includes(CurrentSale) and
		CurrentSale.IsComplete = true and
		CurrentSale.Time = now() and
		pay.Balance = amount-CurrentSale.Amount and
		result = true
}
